interest: Japanese General Sawada's propaganda in Warsaw at the fall of Nanking.
overview: Two reports: General Sawada's 1937 Warsaw interview on Nanking and peace terms, and a 1934 note on General Itagaki in Java.

people.name: Shigeru Sawada
people.role: Major General; Japanese Military Attaché in Warsaw and Chief of the Japanese Military Mission in Poland; former Chief of the Japanese Mission in Manchuria

people.name: Iwane Matsui
people.role: General, Imperial Japanese Army commander of the Japanese expeditionary force capturing Nanking

people.name: Chiang Kai-shek
people.role: Marshal; Generalissimo and head of the Chinese Nationalist Government and armed forces

people.name: Takahashi
people.role: Colonel, Chief of the Chinese Section of the Japanese Army General Staff

people.name: Johannes F. Osten
people.role: Rear Admiral, Director of the Department of Marine of the Netherlands East Indies

subfiles.about: Transmits an English translation of a Polish press interview with the Japanese Military Attaché in Warsaw regarding the capture of Nanking and Japanese strategic objectives in China.
subfiles.from: Office of the U.S. Military Attaché, Warsaw
subfiles.summary: Military Attaché sends a Polish interview in which General Sawada claims Nanking's fall and sets Japan's peace terms, threatening an advance on Hankow.
subfiles.title: U.S. Military Attaché Warsaw Report No. 3034: Japanese Propaganda in Poland (Interview with General Sawada)
subfiles.to: War Department (G-2) / Department of State, Washington, D.C.

subfiles.about: Reports on confidential inquiries made with the Dutch colonial naval administration concerning the visit of Imperial Japanese Army Major General Seishiro Itagaki to Java.
subfiles.summary: Batavia reports consulting Admiral Osten on General Itagaki's visit to Java.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Consulate General Batavia: Visit to Java of Major General Itagaki of the Imperial Japanese Army
